title: IRDAI chairman flags consumer data grab before insurance price quotes, AI-related risks
summary:
Cautioning against insurers demanding personal information before providing premium quotes, IRDAI chairman said consumers should be able to compare prices without sharing details. He also noted how 85% of insurers are using AI for underwriting.

The post IRDAI chairman flags consumer data grab before insurance price quotes, AI-related risks appeared first on MEDIANAMA.
llm_summary: The IRDAI chair warned that insurers are increasingly asking consumers to hand over personal data before they can get a premium quote, arguing that shoppers should be able to compare prices without first revealing sensitive information. He also highlighted that about 85 % of Indian insurers now rely on AI
